headword: {天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}
gloss: innocent and carefree; naive and open; artless

definitions.gloss: innocent and carefree; naive and open; artless; unaffected
definitions.explanation: Describes a personality that is naturally cheerful, open, and free of guile or pretense. Often used as a compliment for people (especially children and young women) who are unselfconsciously honest and sunny in disposition.

examples.japanese: {天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{癒|いや}される→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧。
examples.english: Her innocent, carefree smile is comforting.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) describing an unaffected, naturally cheerful personality. Almost always used positively.

ETYMOLOGY:
{天真|てんしん} (natural innocence) + {爛漫|らんまん} (in full bloom; radiant) — "natural innocence in full bloom."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: an innocent, carefree personality
- {天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: an artless smile
- {天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧: to behave innocently and openly

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective ({天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}な) to modify nouns, or adverbially ({天真爛漫|てんしんらんまん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Most commonly describes children, young women, or fictional characters. Can occasionally carry a slight nuance of being naive or oblivious to social conventions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無邪気|むじゃき}→無邪気：18237_mujaki⟧: innocent; childlike — simpler and more everyday; lacks the literary elegance
- ⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧: honest; obedient — focuses on being straightforward rather than carefree
